game_identity.player_fantasy: Be the last maintenance runner carrying unstable charge from a central core to failing relays fast enough to keep the network alive.
game_identity.central_interaction: Route, recharge, carry, and transfer charge between a central core and four decaying relay beacons.

playable_loop: Move -> recharge at core -> choose upper/lower passage -> carry charge -> read changing relay urgency -> choose which relay to service -> touch beacon to transfer -> manage decay -> stabilize all four or black out -> retry

controls.move: WASD, arrow keys, or standard-mapped gamepad left stick / D-pad
controls.restart: R, Restart button, or standard-mapped gamepad Start

technology_stack: Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript Canvas; local/offline browser; no dependencies
current_milestone: Run Consequence Slice: characterize whether the accepted R1-versus-R3 first choice has consequences that persist into the later shape or margin of the run, rather than only changing the immediately following decision state. Begin from the accepted shared decision state (or an equivalent reproducible normal-run state), make the first differing service choice, then apply one declared branch-neutral decision/recharge/service policy to both branches beyond the accepted second-decision snapshot. Continue through at least one further meaningful service decision and to WON / BLACKOUT when a fixed reasonable step budget permits. Measure comparable trajectory evidence such as elapsed time, runner charge, relay energies, online count, recovery burden, cumulative travel/service cost, core returns, chosen targets, and terminal margin/outcome. Persistent divergence and substantial reconvergence are both valid findings; do not tune either away. Test the accepted model before adding hazards, relay classes, scoring, another chamber, resources, or a new primary verb. Human/fresh-player PLAYTESTED evidence remains required before claims that longer-run consequences are perceived, understandable, fair, tense, strategically interesting, balanced, or fun.
known_failures: Accepted main still has no full normal-input WON session reported PLAYTESTED by a genuine human/fresh player; this remains a validation gap, not an autonomous progression gate.
